headline: 1954–1965 Jim Crow Cost Spike

items.title: Three rising costs
items.detail: C_legitimacy, C_coercive, and C_economic spike maintaining explicit Jim Crow partition.

items.title: Cold War legitimacy
items.detail: Televised Birmingham and Selma brutality; Global South leverage on US moral authority (Dudziak).

items.title: Movement pressure
items.detail: Boycotts, sit-ins, and federal troop deployments push coercion and economic costs unsustainable.

items.title: Interface Swap · Eq. 2.10
items.detail: 1964–1965 statutes retire explicit racial labels for carceral and fiscal proxies.

sources: The Original Power, Ch. 2, §2.3.5, Eq. 2.10; Ch. 3; Dudziak
